description: Actual native planning work on identical frozen pre-change input, with reversible schema normalization only. Evidence-only probes; no runtime timing or memory comparison.

scope.workload: Original native baseline aggregate only: 53 logical slides; not the expanded post-review aggregate or public SDK case matrix.
scope.schemaNormalization: Old intent gains typed Seminar + Contain defaults; no feature, content, asset, or corpus change. Custom original POTX frames/styles retained.
scope.fonts: FontCatalog::default(): no faces, no default family, zero catalog identity; observable deterministic fallback.
scope.operations: Complete plan + encode, seven fresh planning passes per engine. Template compiled once before passes; each pass creates its own planner-internal measurement cache. No composition/render/export.

counterDefinitions.candidateAssignments: Every actual topology/slot-assignment event at existing candidate_count increment, including rejected candidates, summed across all slide attempts.
counterDefinitions.measurements: Every actual existing self.measurements += 1 event after cache lookup and work-limit check; cache misses including rejected fits. Advance-cache entries are not added as measurements.

scope.performance: Neither instrumented BEFORE nor standalone AFTER probe timings/RSS are reported. Original frozen uninstrumented runtime and memory reports remain unchanged, with their original scopes. No speed or memory claim is derived from these counts.

semanticSource.upgrade: Replace little-endian u32 at bytes [4,8) with 6; insert bytes 02 01 at offset 24 (after 16-byte StableId): Seminar, Contain.
semanticSource.reverse: Remove bytes [24,26); replace little-endian u32 at [4,8) with 5.

reproduction.schemaUpgradePython:
from pathlib import Path
r = Path("/tmp/academic-slide-layout")
old = (r / "baseline-inputs/deck-spec.wdsf").read_bytes()
assert old[:8] == b"WDSF\x05\x00\x00\x00"
new = old[:4] + (6).to_bytes(4, "little") + old[8:24] + bytes([2, 1]) + old[24:]
assert new[:4] + (5).to_bytes(4, "little") + new[8:24] + new[26:] == old
out = r / "after-counter-inputs"
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out / "deck-spec.wdsf").write_bytes(new)
(out / "starter.potx").write_bytes((r / "baseline-inputs/starter.potx").read_bytes())
reproduction.replaySetup: In a fresh isolated archive, copy its fixtures/deck-gates to the baseline-inputs directory. Before applying the counter patch, run the unmodified deck_gate_native example on those inputs to generate baseline-native/native.wdpl; require the recorded frozen plan SHA256. Then apply the patch only in the isolated archive. Replace local paths for a new checkout and preserve the byte-identical WDSF upgrade/reversal checks. Never overwrite existing frozen evidence.
reproduction.patchFormat: Zero-context unified diff to preserve measured sources without trailing whitespace in archival diff context; replay verified against the pristine pinned source.
